items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: And Paul Newman is supposed to play a Murray McEachern trombone player and Marin Mcgeford played the trombone parts for him in the film.

ctx.x: Maybe they made those things and he didn't even know they were making them -- that's what I'm saying.
And Paul Newman is supposed to play a Murray McEachern trombone player and Marin Mcgeford played the trombone parts for him in the film.
